background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group AA-, S&P A after its upgrade on 15 Nov 2024 and Moody's A1, all stable. Leverage of 7.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, the only ratio held for it. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is an arbitration dispute; others cover curbed lending to an AI-focused hedge fund after losses, a single-client exposure rather than a group-level concern.
